content: Kintu Allaye Nuh edde hibar fũwati zahazot aššilde hár zandar okkolore monot raikke, Allaye duniyait bataš ba baiye, henot fani homa šuru goijje.
Ar meṛir tolottu fani uṛa edde asmanor faṛa okkol bondo oi giyegoi, asmanottu zór diya o tamigilgoi.
Ar fani meṛir uwottu lami zat taikke; ekšo fõnzaš din šeše fani bout homigiyegoi,
edde hãt maš hõtoro dinor din zahassan Ararot faharor uwore bazigiyegoi.
Bade doš maš foijjonto fani homat roiye; he doš mašor foila dinot faharor tuli okkol dehagiye.
Ar sališ din faraizaigoi bade, Nuhuye zahazot ze zanala goijjil, hiyan hibaye kuille,
edde uggwa hawa baire defeṛaiye, henot hiba meṛir uwottu fani fuwai no zagoi foijjonto aiya zat gorat roiye.
Bade meṛir uwottu fani homigiyegoi ne, hiyan saibolla, hibaye uggwa hoitor baire defeṛaiye.

Kintu hẽtte o šara duniyair uwore fani aššil boli hoitorguwaye hono mikka ṭeng rakibar zaga no fa, hetolla hibar hãse zahazot uwafes firi aišše. Ar hibaye hat niyolaidiyore hibare doijje edde zahazor butore nizor hãse raikke.
Toi hibaye aro hãt din entezar goijje, bade he hoitorguware zahazottu abar baire defeṛaiye.
Hazinna hoitorguwa hibar hãse firi aišše; ar so, hibar ṭuṛot ugguwa tottoza zaitun fata aššil; iyanot Nuhuye buzi faijje, ze meṛir uwottu fani homi giyegoi.
Toi hibaye aro hãt din entezar goijje, he hoitorguware abar baire defeṛaiye, edde hiba hibar hãse ar uwafes firi nu aiye.
Nuhor boyoš sošo ek bosoror foila mašor foila dinor din meṛir uwottu fani fuwaigiyegoi; Toi Nuhuye zahazor sáni kulifelaiye edde baire saiye, ar so, meṛir tola fuwaigiyegoi.
Bade dusora mašor ek kuri hãt dinor din meṛi fuwaigiyegoi.
Toi Allaye Nuhure hodde,
"Tui tor bou ar tor futain edde hitarar bouwain okkolore loi zahazottu niyoli zagoi.
Ar tor fũwati asede hár faik, zanuwar edde buke aṛede zandar, zeto zandar zanuwar ase, hin beggunore tor fũwati niyolai loiai, hitara duniyaire bori tulok, edde fólwala ok edde beši ok."
Toi Nuhuye hibar bou ar futain edde hitarar bouwain okkol beggunore loi zahazottu niyoli aišše.
Ar zar zar zat mozin hár fahari zanuwar edde hár gorwali zanuwar, hár faik, ar meṛir uwore buke solafira gorede hár kissu, zahazottu niyoli aišše.
Tarfore Nuhuye Mabudolla ekkan kurbangah tiyar goijje edde fotti zator paki zanuwar edde faik okkolottu hougguwa loi hiyanor uwore fura-kurbani okkol kurbani goijje.

Mabud he kurbanir kušbot kuši oiye edde mone mone hodde: "Manušolla ãi ar hono din meṛire bodduwa no diyum, zodi o manušor dil zuwan hale loti horaf. Ar zendilla ãi ehon goijji, hendilla ãi ar hár zandarore dongšo no goriyum.
